### ✅ Pre-submission checklist
Before opening a bug, please make sure you have done the following:

- [ ] I have gone through the [Troubleshooting section](https://github.com/gautamkrishnar/blog-post-workflow#-troubleshooting) in the README
- [ ] I have searched for [existing issues](https://github.com/gautamkrishnar/blog-post-workflow/issues) with similar problems
- [ ] I have validated my RSS feed using an RSS validator
- [ ] I have verified that my RSS feed is publicly accessible
- [ ] I have checked my GitHub Actions workflow permissions (Settings → Actions → General → Workflow permissions)
- [ ] I have tested with the latest version of the action
- [ ] I have included all relevant configuration and error information above 
- [ ] I had followed all the steps mentioned in the [documentation](https://github.com/gautamkrishnar/blog-post-workflow)
